title: Postnikov truncation couple terms and canonical arrows
statement:
Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], let $D(\mathcal A)$ be the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with its standard t-structure and truncations [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category], and let $T:D(\mathcal A)\to\mathcal B$ be a functor. For $n,r,P,Q\in\mathbf Z$, define $T^n(M)=T(M[n])$, and define the functors
$$D_r^{P,Q}(L)=T^{P+Q-r}(\tau_{\le Q}L),\qquad E_r^{P,Q}(L)=T^{P+Q-r}(\tau_{\ge Q}\tau_{<Q+1}L).$$
The single-degree truncation $\tau_{\ge Q}\tau_{<Q+1}L$ is the canonical truncation representative of $H^Q(L)[-Q]$. Define $\alpha_r^{P,Q}(L):D_r^{P,Q}(L)\to D_r^{P-1,Q+1}(L)$ by applying $T^{P+Q-r}$ to the canonical inclusion $\tau_{\le Q}L\to\tau_{\le Q+1}L$, with the equality of total degrees inserted. Define $g_r^{P,Q}(L):D_r^{P,Q}(L)\to E_r^{P,Q}(L)$ by applying $T^{P+Q-r}$ to the second arrow of the canonical truncation triangle
$$\tau_{<Q}L\longrightarrow\tau_{<Q+1}L\longrightarrow\tau_{\ge Q}\tau_{<Q+1}L\longrightarrow(\tau_{<Q}L)[1].$$
Define $f_r^{P,Q}(L):E_r^{P,Q}(L)\to D_r^{P+2,Q-1}(L)$ by applying the shift $[P+Q-r]$ and then $T$ to that triangle's boundary arrow, using the canonical comparison $[1][P+Q-r]\cong[(P+2)+(Q-1)-r]$ and the equality $\tau_{<Q}=\tau_{\le Q-1}$. These definitions impose no homological, additivity, boundedness or convergence hypothesis on $T$.
